notes.title: Vending Machine Co. Demo v0.6.7 - Better Sell Balance & Market Search
notes.content:

[/list]

[h2]UI & Visuals[/h2]

[*] AreaApp tooltip yOffset fix for smoother display
[*] HUD updates: hideHUD action refined, new currency handling (LS+J), and debug panel improvements
[*] Tablet visuals updated with fresh art assets and auto-importer fixes
[/list]

[h2]Tools & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] SpriteFilterModeConverter tool added, making filter mode changes easier
[*] Applied optimized max-size flow for images, improving memory performance
[/list]

[h2]Misc Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Market filter improvements (FilterItemByName + tablet art import)
[*] Various text updates and minor stability improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Vending Machine Co. Demo v0.6.6 - Hot Items & Sell Chance
notes.content:
[b]Vending Machine Co – Update 0.6.6[/b]

Hey Vending Tycoons! 🥤 We’re back with another update, and this one focuses on making your vending empire smoother, smarter, and way more strategic. Let’s dive into the highlights:

[h2]🛠️ Major Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]No More Vanishing Stock[/b]  
Some of you reported that buying a lot of items at once sometimes caused them to mysteriously disappear. We tracked down the issue and squashed it. Now, when you bulk buy, every item you’ve paid for will properly land in your hands, ready to stock up your machines.
[/list]

[h2]🔥 New Feature: Hot Items Button[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ever wondered what’s selling like crazy in each part of the city?  
[*]We’ve added a brand-new [b]Hot Items[/b] button right on the map. Click it, and you’ll instantly see which products are trending in which neighborhoods.  
[*]This should help you make better stocking decisions, whether you’re placing soda near the salarymen, toys near families, or energy drinks in areas buzzing with night owls.  
[/list]

Smart vending is all about knowing your crowd. With this tool, you’ll never be left guessing.

[h2]📊 New Feature: Sell Chance Tooltips[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pricing strategy just got a major boost.  
[*]Now, every item you place in a vending machine shows a [b]Sell Chance[/b] value in its tooltip. This number tells you how likely it is that customers will buy at the current price.  
[/list]

Here’s how to use it:  
[list]
[*]If the sell chance is [b]too low[/b] → customers aren’t biting. Maybe drop the price to move that merchandise.  
[*]If the sell chance is [b]too high[/b] → your stock is basically flying off the shelves. Maybe you’re leaving money on the table. Raise the price and maximize your profits.  
[/list]

This small addition gives you much more control over your strategy. It’s a real supply & demand simulator now, and you’re the mastermind running it.

[h2]💡 Wrapping Up[/h2]
This update may look small on paper, but it’s a big step toward making [b]Vending Machine Co[/b] a deeper and more rewarding experience. Between [b]bug stability[/b], [b]smarter stocking tools[/b], and [b]dynamic pricing guidance[/b], your vending empire just got a lot more powerful.

As always, thank you for your amazing support and feedback. Keep sharing your vending stories, strategies, and memes with us. They help shape every patch we release.

Go forth, stock smart, and may your machines never run empty! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649874/863754ef83d018e2096206be3f389bbd428d108f.png[/img]

notes.title: Vending Machine Co. – Demo Release v0.6.0 🏙️
notes.content:
The [b]Vending Machine Co.[/b] demo has been out for a week now 🎉 and since release we’ve been rolling out bug fix updates and balance tweaks.  

If you played early (even before the official announcement) — thank you so much for your feedback 💛. You’ve helped us smooth things out, and we hope you’ll give it another try!  

The demo now features [b]2 unlockable areas[/b] to explore:  
✨ [b]Komorebi Homes[/b] — a peaceful, family-oriented neighborhood  
✨ [b]Otaku Alley[/b] — a pop culture hub filled with arcades and anime stores  

With better balance and (hopefully) fewer bugs 🐛, it’s the perfect time to jump back in!  


[h2]🌆 Full Game 🌆[/h2]

The full release of [b]Vending Machine Co.[/b] will feature even more areas to explore and plenty of new content — items, minigames, collectables, and cozy places to just “hang out” in our Japanese city. Here’s a taste of what’s coming:

👉 Play the free demo today and let us know what you think!
